text:
```yaml
name: Close Inactive Issues
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  close-inactive-issues:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/stale@v10
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          stale-issue-message: 'This issue has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had recent activity over the past 700 days. It will be closed if no further activity occurs within the next 30 days.'
          close-issue-message: 'This issue was closed because it has been inactive for over 2 years.'
          days-before-stale: 700
          days-before-close: 30
          stale-issue-label: 'stale'
          close-issue-label: 'closed:inactive'
          exempt-issue-labels: 'data-issue'
          only-labels: ''
          remove-stale-when-updated: true
          close-issue-reason: 'not_planned'
```
